Benfica seasons|123rd season]] in existence and its 93rd consecutive season in the top flight of [[Football in Portugal|Portuguese football]]. Domestically, Benfica plays in the [[2026–27 Primeira Liga|Primeira Liga]], and also compete in the [[2026–27 Taça da Liga|Taça da Liga]] and [[2026–27 Taça de Portugal|Taça de Portugal]]. In Europe, Benfica plays in the [[2026–27 UEFA Europa League|UEFA Europa League]].
